given: vehicle v1 with a daily item i1 (no kit); Monday's obligation for i1 is unsatisfied after its late limit L
the read instant is Wednesday 12:00 (station-local); the readiness look-back is the seven days before the read instant
when: read the current fleet-readiness summary with no later check
a later effective Pass for i1 is recorded and the summary is read again
the later check is a Fail instead of a Pass
the obligation's due instant D is one microsecond less than, exactly, or more than seven days before the read instant; a read at exactly L versus after L
a default as-of read at an instant before a later invalidation was recorded
read the readiness page, the readiness API response, and every report output that already contains fleet-readiness counts

an earlier obligation of i1 is unsatisfied after G but not after L when a later obligation of i1 (an explicit ad hoc order whose on-time window contains the check) is satisfied by an effective check; read at L - 1 microsecond, at L and at L + 1 microsecond
then: Monday's obligation counts as Overdue and as Missed in the current summary

it no longer counts as Overdue but still counts as Missed until its due instant D is more than seven days before the read instant; history still shows it as permanently Overdue (missed); the readiness page shows the Missed count per vehicle and in the fleet totals
the same Overdue and Missed counts apply and the item stays not ready (section 5.4)

the obligation is in neither count once its due instant D is more than seven days before the read instant, and remains eligible for Missed at exactly seven days; a check at exactly L still completes it and it is missed only when the read instant is after L (SCH-2)
the default as-of Missed count is as known then and ignores the later invalidation; the as-of Overdue count follows section 19.3; a stored summary equals a recomputation from events (section 19)
each shows the Missed count: the page per vehicle and in the fleet totals, the API in its response, and the reports as a summarized count (the report list and formats stay open, OQ-61)
the earlier obligation is counted neither as Overdue nor as Missed before L and at L; after L it is counted as Missed and still not as Overdue (RPT-5a (a), amendment 1.29.0)
notes: Language-neutral behavioral contract for SPEC amendment 1.28.0 (issue #77), with case (9) from amendment 1.29.0 (issue #91) and the due-instant age anchor from amendment 1.30.0 (issue #94); runner implementation is deferred like the other contracts.
